QuantityIncluded.description: Quota or units included in the subscription.

QuantityCurrent.description: Current available quantity for the customer.

Properties.description:
Behavioural flag on a subscription feature. Multiple values may apply to a single feature.

* `UpdatableBeforeSubscription` — quantity can be set before subscribing
* `UpdatableAfterSubscription` — quantity can be changed after subscribing
* `UpdateAtFullPrice` — quantity increase is always charged at full price
* `FreeInTrial` — feature is free during the trial period
Properties.title: SubscriptionFeatureProperties
